requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

803-1486-4231-5400--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Arcane Adaptation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Synth Infiltrator. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Arcane Adaptation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

3518-3605-3734-5131.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {3}{U/P}, causing it to enter as an artifact copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

3755-4359-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4381-4694-5231-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-5231-7306.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Repeat from step 1.

2558-2921-7916.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, its living weapon ability granted to it by Ekthi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token. It'll enter as a 1/1 due to Ekthi's static effect.
When the Phyrexian Germ enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Phyrexian Germ.
Repeat from step 2.

372-2438-4783.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Choose to have Abdel Adrian returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Hellkite Courser returns to the battlefield from exile, triggering itself, putting Abdel Adrain from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Hellkite Courser and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each exiled permanent.
Repeat.

2457-4289-7060-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2034-5477-5660-6791-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

3490-5231-6458-6996.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
3490-5231-6458-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1806-2060-2445-5231-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2558-5727-6705-6798.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
When the Frog enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1580-2060-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
413-1580-2060-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

2713-3719-5326-6558.notablePrerequisites: Naga Fleshcrafter has a power of at least 2.
2713-3719-5326-6558.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Naga Fleshcrafter and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Naga Fleshcrafter from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Naga Fleshcrafter to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Naga Fleshcrafter enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-3817-5686-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-3817-5686-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1251-1563-2457-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

790-2152-4179.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-2152-4179.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control infect until end of turn.
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

requires.n: Permanent with Affinity and a Generic Mana Cost

542--77.easyPrerequisites: One of the affinity permanents must be on the battlefield with the other in your hand.
542--77.notablePrerequisites: You control enough applicable permanents such that you can cast both affinity permanents for {0}.
542--77.description:
Cast the affinity permanent in your hand by paying {0}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the other affinity permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2532-4031-5200.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2034-2532-4031-5200.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Ardent Electromancer with haste.
When Ardent Electromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Ardent Electromancer token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Ardent Electromancer token dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat.

1491-3129-3755-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-3129-3755-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-3129-3755-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1742-4094-5742-5743.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1742-4094-5742-5743.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart, adding {B}.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2533-2719-4681-5147.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Repeat.

304-478-804-2821-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
304-478-804-2821-4249.description:
Animate Candelabra using Tough Cookie
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {U} equal to your devotion to blue.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Nykthos.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

586-2350-2438-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1479-5033-5671.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-5033-5671.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and The Necrobloom trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant or a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant or a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

985-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat

2291-2792-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Coiling Stalker does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{G}{U}.
2291-2792-3489.description:
Declare Coiling Stalker as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{G}{U}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Coiling Stalker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Coiling Stalker's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{G} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Coiling Stalker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1242-1656-2013.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
It is your combat phase.
1242-1656-2013.description:
During your combat phase, activate Necrotic Ooze using Kjeldoran Elite Guard's ability by tapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

2734-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Your life total is at least 50 minus your storm count.
2734-4740.description:
Cast Cyberdrive Awakener by paying {5}{U}.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
When Cyberdrive Awakener enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing Aetherflux Reservoir to become a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.
Give Aetherflux Reservoir lifelink.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 5.

570-1376-3314-3562-5168.notablePrerequisites: Chulane, Faeburrow Elder, Bloom Tender and Priest of Titania do not have summoning sickness.
570-1376-3314-3562-5168.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder and Bloom Tender by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{W}{W}{U}{U}.
Activate Pirest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Sky Hussar by paying {3}{W}{U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Sky Hussar to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control a black permanent, red permanent, an additional mana-producing creature, and/or at least one additional Elf, this combo nets infinite mana.

659-2178-2813.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Krenko.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Goblin.
659-2178-2813.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing a Goblin token, targeting any artifact.
When the Goblin dies, Krenko triggers, untapping itself.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Goblin Trashmaster abilities, destroying the targeted artifact(s).
You may also repeat this loop whenever an artifact enters the battlefield.

2347-3304-4067-5047.notablePrerequisites: The Swarmlord has two +1/+1 counters on it for each time you've cast it from the command zone this game.
2347-3304-4067-5047.description:
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing The Swarmlord.
Choose to return The Swarmlord to the command zone from your graveyard.
The Swarmlord dies, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Greater Good ability, causing you to draw a number of cards equal to The Swarmlord's power, and then discard three cards.
Activate Firemind Vessel by tapping it, adding two mana of different colors.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Firemind Vessel.
Repeat from step 5 until you have enough mana to cast The Swarmlord.
Cast The Swarmlord from the command zone by paying {3}{U}{R}{G} and commander tax, causing The Swarmlord to enter the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters for each time you've cast it from the command zone this game.
Repeat.

1824-2661-4924.notablePrerequisites:
You have not completed nor are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation.
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
1824-2661-4924.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Acererak enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to venture into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2034-3132-3398-4871.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block and kill Bladewing and Hellkite Charger.
You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
2034-3132-3398-4871.description:
Declare Bladewing and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Bladewing.
Bladewing triggers, creating at least three 2/2 Zombie Knight creature tokens.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Bladewing and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Zombie Knights, adding six {C}.
The Zombie Knights die, triggering Pitiless Plunderer three times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
